d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ne aasiyan deshon ke sath bharat ke majbut hote sanbandhon par jor dete hue kaha hai ki ye sajhedari bharat ki ekt eest niti ki dhuri hone ke sath-sath mahasagar vijan ke lie bhi mahatvapurn hai. pradhanmantri ne kshetriy sahyog, aapsi vishvas aur sajha vikas ke lakshyon ko aage barhane men aasiyan ki aham bhumika ko rekhankit kiya. vahin, jharkhand men neta pratipaksh babulal marandi ne rajy ki kanun vyavastha ko lekar hemant sarkar par nishana sadha hai. unhonne aarop lagaya ki rajy men kanun vyavastha puri tarah dhvast ho chuki hai aur samaj ka har varg…
